folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B386: actual play inputs and harness-qualified findings
folds.body:
The full C2 checkpoint and all four actual area reports were read: [continuation](C2_CONTINUATION_PLAY.md), [combat](C2_COMBAT_PLAY.md), [LOTM](C2_LOTM_PLAY.md) and [Mistglass](C2_MISTGLASS_PLAY.md). These reports are now actual-content inputs, not transitive summary credit. The startup observer and select routes deliver ordinary native controls; async authority/reload waiting fixes a runner observation race, not injected gameplay. MCP instruments the selected source tree and does not simply play the recorded dist hash. Committed-candidate evidence excludes newer primary cultivation, baggage and review systems.

CCC1's “already applied” return is qualified by deterministic crypto reseeding on realm reinstall and the UUID-only diagnosis. That supports a harness cause, not a confirmed native continuation defect or a fresh browser reproduction. Fresh/reciprocal later checkpoint and exported-path resume have their exact reached-state proof; initial-return, law memory and U1 baggage remain unexercised or unavailable in that candidate, not negative reproduction. The blank accidental limit-ledger entry retains raw history but conveys no actionable limitation.

CBC1's empty scoped action list does not prove no withdrawal control elsewhere. One native group win and a mid-fight save/load preserve their exact active actor/vitals/location; neither is defeat/escape or after-outcome review. A Combat-filtered Reports exchange is not the dedicated review surface. CLC1–CLC8 prove two declared probe lives: dose possession, irreversible ingestion, usable learned control, bounded sample inference, paid local role work and held assessment reward remain different. The funded-formula barrier left brewing unstarted; no balance defect or whole-source fidelity follows.

CMC1 preserves a specific missing Meditation-learning route in the reached Village views, not a game-wide impossibility. Method/practice/reserve, dose purchase, sluice and reached-state persistence are exercised; purification outcome is not. Vessel/brood/seedbed controls absent from the committed tree do not reproduce or disprove their later primary work. All desktop/visual claims remain outside these MCP text journeys. Historical full-suite environmental/timeout failures and narrower reruns remain separate inputs; final tool/14consumer checks are their own slice, not a whole-suite rerun. Current AD42 keeps human review optional. No new tools, game run, save access, source change, agent or process action occurred here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B386: frozen sessions, mirrors and exact check windows
folds.body:
This entire E4 checkpoint, all E4-F/M rows and final identities were read. Session IDs are server process keys, not durable save identities; replacement/reload/import/close affect only their selected key. The lamp quote uses the actual scenario/native quote owner without exposing an arbitrary registry. Quote immutability compared observer snapshots after the earlier test mistakenly compared mutating save calls. A startup self-check typo and a native launch rejection are diagnostic failures with their own corrected boundaries, not gameplay outcomes.

The74-input frozen manifest includes the instrumented bundle, runner/worker/helper/host/static content. Its independently recorded native dist is not proof of source-build correspondence; external Node/Electron/automation remains a host dependency. Replacing changed checkout inputs, manifest tamper rejection and an existing session's private copy are distinct assertions. The externally tampered test snapshot cannot be reused for a new session just because the running session kept its original bytes. Frozen identity is not a guarantee of current installed tooling or universal reproducibility.

The native CDP PNG is real rendered Electron evidence at its declared1920 target, yet it is a saved-state mirror rather than the headless session's transient panel, focus or exact paused time. Screenshot success grants no full native action backend, foreground-profile access or app adoption. The separated helper converts unsupported native launch into an honest error while preserving MCP; DOM text is not substituted as image proof. Exact transient same-session screenshots remain an unimplemented capability proposal, not a new required gate.

The15-tool check, native-only and final freeze-only checks use different final-helper windows. The20/21 focused result retains a reproduced inherited300-character log-excerpt assertion; four localhost full-suite failures have an environmental9-case retry, not a new green full run. Unchanged runtime/source inputs distinguish that assertion from an M10 regression. Old branch integration status, byte hashes, external artifact paths, worker state and host permissions remain dated receipts. No manifest, image, tool launch, runtime, source test or process was freshly exercised here; AD42 keeps optional taste review separate.
